propositions: T10 rubric must add an exact durable-infrastructure scope clause partitioning routine durable IaC/config checks from transient throwaway de-risk experiments.

The scope clause must be immediately followed by an exact four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier preserving destructive-apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, and untrusted-network-endpoint-auth protections for transient infrastructure.
The T10 rubric must not reference T15 or assign scope to any other overlay to maintain independence.
A packaged eval spec with ten balanced dataset cases—five pass and five finding—must cover transient throwaway probes, durable lifecycle, shared-data protection, and secret/authentication safeguards.
Offline text-contract tests must lock the exact scope clause, exact qualifier, and absence of cross-criterion references; agentic finding behavior is proved by live criteria eval.

The offline T10 test and strict packaged-spec registration must be integrated into the existing test suite so that rebar criteria eval and rebar explain render the durable/transient partition with retained safety protections.
